conclusion: Preserve large continuous organic contact platforms only when the exact source footprint matches the corresponding contact/interface component and satisfies the existing big-overhang and configured support-spacing geometry checks. A true TopContact must match a lower TopInterface; a generic TopInterface must match an upper TopContact. All other paths retain the established cleanup. Cache each generator layer's geometry and platform eligibility within one cleanup pass to avoid repeated large-polygon work. This is source- and parameter-driven, not a model-name, coordinate, or forced-density rule.
